question.text:
Let a, λ, u ∈R . Consider the system of linear equations
ax+2y=λ
3x-2y=μ
Which of the following statement(s) is (are) correct ?

options.text: If <math><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the system has infinitely many solutions for all values of <math><mi>λ</mi></math> and <math><mi>μ</mi></math>
If <math><mi>a</mi><mi> </mi><mo>≠</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the system has a unique solution for all values of <math><mi>λ</mi></math> and <math><mi>μ</mi></math>
If <math><mi>λ</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>μ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the system has infinitely many solutions for <math><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></math>
If <math><mi>λ</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>μ</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the system has no solution for <math><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></math>

solution.text:
ax+2y=λ
3x-2y=μ
If a=-3 lines will be parallel or coincident, parallel for λ+μ≠0 and coincident if λ+μ=0 and if a ≠ -3 lines are intersecting ⇒ unique solution.
If parallel then no solution & If coincident then infinite solution
